name: Iconly Pro
summary: Icon library of 40,000+ flat, animated and 3D icons with a web app, Figma plugin and SVG, PNG, JSX export.
description: Iconly Pro is an icon pack library for designers, developers and product teams: 40,000+ icons in 6 styles (light, outline, bold, two-tone, duotone, bulk) and 3 types (flat, animated, 3D), designed on a 24x24 grid with 70+ categories. Browse, search and download from the web app or insert icons in Figma, export as SVG, PNG, JSX or TSX, and customise colors, sizes and strokes.
contains: 6 styles: light, outline, bold, two-tone, duotone, bulk
Starter tier with 2,000+ icons, Personal $8/mo, Team $7 per user/mo, Lifetime $189
